title: Memory, pager, ext4 and I/O repair
summary: Make PageBacked the canonical ordinary-file cache, extract a reusable pure ext4 pager behind retained leases, preserve the existing I/O-manager execution path, add owner-driven global memory pressure, and close Tier 1/Tier 2 correctness plus rustc performance acceptance.

steps.title: Make PageSlot the only file-page semantic authority
steps.notes: Completed in foundation lane at 54b7e540. PageSlot is the file-page state authority; replacement marks no longer own dirty/writeback semantics outside PageSlot.

steps.title: Make clean reclaim withdrawal and refetch generation-safe
steps.notes: Completed in foundation lane at 362ae1c5. Clean page reclaim uses PageSlot claims so matching owner withdrawal moves resident slot and index together while stale claims/completions cannot affect a newer generation.

steps.title: Canonicalize ext4 file PageContainers and retire runtimes
steps.notes: Completed in foundation lane at 5ba8442b. Ext4 file PageContainers and runtimes are canonicalized so one mount/object identity resolves to one live page container and runtime registration/retirement is idempotent.

steps.title: Settle journal resources by durability phase
steps.notes: Completed in journal lane at 7e6e37e0 and tightened in foundation lane at e7285e5f. Journal reservations now settle by durability phase: pre-commit abort releases without advancing, submitted commit error quarantines durability-unknown space, checkpoint error retains retry state, and checkpoint success releases/advances once. The foundation follow-up added prepared-transaction coverage for durability-phase reservation settlement; broad tx-ext4 verification remains deferred because the host volume had about 278 MiB free.

steps.title: Introduce the retained multi-page PageDataLease
steps.notes: Completed in foundation lane at 08075df7 and integrated into journal lane at 37b32a0b. PageBacked constructs and settles retained multi-page PageDataLease capability without introducing disposable copied batch vocabulary.

steps.title: Aggregate one fsync frontier into bounded transactions
steps.notes: Completed in journal lane through 03ae38ca, 695c066b and 84c4aff3, then tightened in foundation lane through de5ecd66, 6cf6e029, 89d90dec, 9d9cc930 and 88d1d813. Multi-page fsync frontiers aggregate into bounded JBD2 transactions, after-images are grouped by metadata home block, concurrent fsync submissions join a covering transaction instead of contending for one active scalar submission, retained batch writeback settles each page by generation, and PageMarks no longer duplicate dirty/writeback authority outside PageSlot. Commit 88d1d813 preserves sparse fsync frontiers by planning explicit (PageIndex, payload) rows from the retained PageDataLease view instead of synthesizing all pages between the first and last dirty page.

steps.title: Route namespace mutation through one atomic JBD2 transaction
steps.notes: Completed routing slice across create/mkdir/unlink/rmdir/link/rename via plan -> JBD2 admission -> Yield(wait source) -> durable cache publication. Landed in journal lane commits 38f96e51, 046e18a5 and 48d36bdb; coordinator spot-check passed the recorded ext4/lib, pager_mock, fmt and diff gates. Remaining production blockers move to T6/V gates: pure planners still lack complete link-count/orphan lifecycle, cross-parent '..' updates, replacement-directory parent-count semantics, and crash/replay/e2fsck/xfstests witnesses.

steps.title: Extract kernel-neutral pager APIs and tx-ext4-pager
steps.notes: Completed in journal lane at 99ebad1d. Added no_std tx-pager-api and tx-ext4-pager crates plus a tx-ext4 compatibility seam; tx-ext4-pager depends only on the neutral API and tx-ext4-format, with no PPN, BioVec, reactor, PageBacked or device-queue dependency. T5/T6 lowering and production cutover are intentionally deferred.

steps.title: Freeze metadata generations and complete typed durability graphs
steps.notes: Completed in journal lane at f40ebcb1. Frozen metadata generations retain one immutable after-image lease through both journal write and checkpoint; later mutations get a new generation. Ordinary data writes now require explicit L4 IoDataSource. The lane verified format 32, pager 3, tx-ext4 54, format/diff/pure-crate boundaries and progress validate; coordinator spot-check reran frozen metadata and journal prepared-transaction tests. Full cargo -q xtask unit was blocked by disk exhaustion, not a test failure.

steps.title: Cut production ext4 over and retire legacy mutation paths
steps.notes: Completed in journal integration lane through 016ee6f7, d09ae141, cd2f746c, 42d71882, fde7f4d6 and 8f05227f. The production code slice adds the memory-io-ownership invariant gate, rejects legacy RW mount admission with ENOSYS, prevents dynamic non-RO mount(2) from falling back to the direct pager, keeps replay as an explicit recovery-only exception, and integrates foundation PageSlot authority so batch fsync enters, completes and aborts writeback only through PageSlot generations. Coordinator spot-check passed cargo xtask lint invariants memory-io-ownership, cargo test -p tx-subsystems --lib clean_reclaim -- --test-threads=1, cargo test -p tx-ext4 --lib -- --test-threads=1, git diff --check, cargo -q xtask unit, and cargo xtask test busybox-boot --target rv64-qemu --timeout-ms 60000. steps.title: Add allocator snapshots and the managed AllocationGateway
steps.notes: Completed in pressure lane at b9c93f14, after owner-driven pressure contracts at df9468be. Allocator exposes facts/fast path only; the managed gateway owns bounded slow-path retry and does not call providers while allocator state is held.

steps.title: Add the clean PageBacked ReclaimProvider
steps.notes: Completed in pressure lane at 3fa43309. PageBacked exposes a bounded clean reclaim provider while snapshot, claim, revalidate and withdrawal remain owner operations.

steps.title: Run pure policy and bounded background reclaim episodes
steps.notes: Completed in pressure lane at 21511614. Policy consumes immutable snapshots and emits bounded intent; coordinator schedules providers and waits without holding allocator, epoch or owner mutation guards. Verified with focused tx-services memory_pressure/coordinator tests plus scoped format and dependency scans; final PageBacked provider link pass was space-limited before later cleanup.

steps.title: Add bounded dirty writeback and ext4/VFS/Zone providers
steps.notes: Completed in pressure lane at 48ae1e1e. Clustered writeback uses existing PageBacked L4 admission, has bounded in-flight work, dirty throttling and independent emergency credits, and does not make the I/O manager a cache owner. Verified with pressure writeback/PageBacked focused tests, tx-ext4 --lib, progress validate, docs lint and scoped boundary greps.

steps.title: Add refault feedback and migrate managed allocation callers
steps.notes: Completed in pressure lane at 7c4394dd. Policy receives immutable fast-refault, turn-distance and service-cost feedback from provider snapshots; PageBacked keeps only bounded ghost candidate IDs and no page/PPN/lease ownership. The planned memory-io-ownership invariant rule is absent in current xtask, so the lane used report-only api-language lint and retained workload tuning as future evidence.
